facts.fact: The Central Bank of Libya says it holds a licensing regulation for electronic payment companies, which it intends to update with IMF technical support to prepare initial drafts.
facts.system: Licensing regulation for electronic payment companies

LBY.note: Document states nothing on consumer protection rules or redress.
Document states nothing on cross-border payments.
Document states nothing on government payments to people.
Only FATF and cybersecurity standards are mentioned as alignment aims; no ISO/IEC standard or membership stated.
Document gives no survey share of adults with an account.
Document does not state a mobile money or e-money service in service.
Document states nothing on revenue collection.
